Welcome

A lawn made for grand days

Brij Vatika hosts weddings, receptions, engagements and family functions on a beautifully landscaped 55,000 sq. ft. lawn with heavy greenery, a fully air-conditioned banquet hall and five air-conditioned guest rooms.
